name: MonarchColorPicker
title: ColorPicker
summary: Picks a color from named swatches, or any color by its hex value. The value is lower-case #rrggbb text.
whenToUse: To let people choose a color for a label, a tag, a calendar or a brand setting.
whenNotToUse: For a choice between a few named options that are not colors use radio buttons or a segmented control. For a color that is part of the theme, use MonarchTheme, not a picker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchColorPicker(value: String?, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, swatches: List<MonarchColorSwatch> = MonarchColorPickerDefaults.swatches(), enabled: Boolean = true, allowCustom: Boolean = true, label: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, labels: MonarchColorPickerLabels = MonarchColorPickerLabels())
class MonarchColorSwatch { val hex: String; val name: String; val color: Color }
fun MonarchColorSwatch.Companion.of(hex: String, name: String): MonarchColorSwatch?
class MonarchColorPickerLabels(swatches: String? = null, swatch: ((name: String, hex: String) -> String)? = null, hex: String? = null, invalid: String? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The color as #rrggbb, or null for none. Text that is not a hex color is treated as none.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with lower-case #rrggbb when a swatch or valid hex text selects a different color.

options.name: swatches
options.description: The presets. An empty list shows only the hex field.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can change the color.

options.name: allowCustom
options.description: Shows the hex field for any color.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label above the swatches, read as a heading.

states.name: selected
states.description: The chosen swatch has a 2dp ring in the default text color and a mark in the middle, and the selected state.

states.name: custom color
states.description: A color that is no swatch selects none; the hex field shows it, with the color at its start.

states.name: no selection
states.description: No swatch is marked and the hex field is empty.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Hex text that is not a color stays in the field with the error message and the error state; nothing is selected.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The label and helper use the disabled text color, swatches and the field do not respond. Swatch colors are the app's data and are not changed.

appearance: Swatches are 32dp circles in a wrapping row, each in a 48dp target, with a 1dp outline in the default border color. The selected one has a ring in the default text color and an 8dp surface-coloured mark in the middle. The hex field is a MonarchTextField. Ring and mark take their roles from the theme in every theme; the swatch colors do not change with the theme.
platformNotes: Android has no system color picker, so the custom part is the hex field (the web also has the browser's color input; iOS uses the system ColorPicker and has no hex field). The value is the same lower-case #rrggbb text as on the web and iOS, so a stored color moves between platforms; opacity is not supported. The selection mark is a ring and a dot rather than the web's check glyph, because Monarch for Android bundles no icons. The web's roving arrow-key focus is not reproduced: each swatch is its own focusable radio button. The web's hidden form input (name) has no meaning in a Compose app.
accessibility: Each swatch is a radio button named by its name and value, for example "Blue, #2563eb", with the selected state on the chosen one.
The swatches are a selectable group named "Preset colors".
The selection is also a ring and a mark, so it does not depend on seeing the color.
Every swatch has a 48dp touch target reserved in the layout and draws the Monarch focus ring.
The label is a heading; the hex field has a label and announces its error through the error semantics.
Text grows with the font size setting and the swatches wrap.
edgeCases: Hex text is checked when the user presses Done or leaves the field; empty text restores the current value.
#rgb, rgb and upper-case text are accepted and normalised to lower-case #rrggbb.
MonarchColorSwatch.of returns null for a value that is not a hex color, so listOfNotNull skips it.
Choosing the color that is already selected does not call onValueChange.

examples.title: In a Field
Own presets without the hex field
examples.code:
MonarchColorPicker(
    value = color,
    onValueChange = { color = it },
    swatches = listOfNotNull(
        MonarchColorSwatch.of("#0d9488", "Teal"),
        MonarchColorSwatch.of("#9333ea", "Purple"),
    ),
    allowCustom = false,
    label = "Tag color",
)
